metadata.description: Comprehensive synthetic graph banking dataset with planted ground-truth cycles, smurfing, dispersion, communities, and layering.

notes.content: Subpoena issued for Shell Co bank records in Panama. Corresponding Swiss account shows incoming matching balance.
Aggregator account ACC-SMURF-AGG-01 opened 14 days prior to first structuring transaction. High likelihood of shell entity.
SAR (Suspicious Activity Report) filed with FinCEN reference #SAR-2026-9921-X.
